client_id.description: REQUIRED, or OMIT if Authorization header is passed

client_secret.description: REQUIRED, or OMIT if Authorization header is passed

grant_type.description: Grant type used to specify request for auth code or refresh token

code.description: REQUIRED for grant_type 'authorization_code', OMIT for 'refresh_token'. The authorization_code received from the authorization server (Authorization Code Flow)

redirect_uri.description: REQUIRED. MUST match the 'redirect_uri' parameter included in the authorization request (Authorization Code Flow)

refresh_token.description: REQUIRED for grant_type 'refresh_token', OMIT for 'authorization_code'. The refresh_token issued to the client (Refresh Token Flow)
